### Batch 2 OpenSSL core helper/capability verification

- Initial focused sweep:
  - Loop compiled and ran `tests/test_openssl_*.pas` plus `tests/openssl/test_openssl_features.pas` and `tests/openssl/test_openssl_ca_autoload.pas`.
  - First result: failed at `tests/test_openssl_loader_required_symbol_contract.pas`.
  - Failure detail: access violation in the AES missing-required-symbol section before assertions could complete.
- Root cause investigation:
  - `LoadAESFunctions(ALibHandle: THandle)` and same-pattern low-level loaders used `THandle`.
  - On Linux, `SizeOf(THandle)=4` and `SizeOf(TLibHandle)=8`.
  - Passing a dynamic library handle through `THandle` truncated it, so `GetProcAddress` could receive an invalid handle and crash.
- Fix:
  - Added `TOpenSSLLibHandle` in `src/fafafa.ssl.openssl.loader.pas`.
  - Updated AES/SHA/EC/MD/DES/BLAKE2 loader entrypoints to accept `TOpenSSLLibHandle`.
- Focused failing regression after fix:
  - `tests/test_openssl_loader_required_symbol_contract.pas`
  - Result: PASS, `Tests Passed: 13`, `Tests Failed: 0`
- Full OpenSSL focused sweep after fix:
  - Loop compiled and ran `tests/test_openssl_*.pas` plus `tests/openssl/test_openssl_features.pas` and `tests/openssl/test_openssl_ca_autoload.pas`.
  - Result: PASS, `openssl contracts passed: 38`

    - rename:

      - `TestCallbackReplayProviderInstallHelperRuntimeRetainsReplayTruthAcrossSessionCacheToggles`
        -> `TestCallbackReplayProviderInstallHelperRuntimeRetainsReplayTruthAcrossLocalGateToggles`
    - 使用 `IFreePascalManagedEarlyDataReplayLedger` 直接对 active installed ledger 执行：
      - `SetEnabled(False/True)`
      - `SetCapacity(0/8)`
    - 这样只切 local replay gate，不破坏 resumption cache/runtime transcript

- Continued the product-completeness roadmap with the third pure Pascal backend family instead of reopening old closeout lines.

- This family first closed the functional server-side gap:
  - FreePascal context now exposes a bounded in-memory resumption cache
  - full handshakes now derive a resumption PSK, store a resumable session, and emit encrypted `NewSessionTicket`
  - resumed `DoAccept(...)` now emits `ServerHello.pre_shared_key(selected_identity=0)` and skips `Certificate / CertificateVerify`
  - `IsSessionReused` now matches the real server-side resumed path
- Then this family closed the main security/correctness risk that was still below rustls-level expectations:
  - server-side resumed accept no longer treats cache hit as sufficient
  - binder mismatch is now fail-closed
  - added a focused contract that a tampered PSK binder must make server `Accept` fail
- Enabling strict binder verification exposed a real root cause in the client-side/test-side PSK `ClientHello` construction:
  - the old flow computed binder from one partial `ClientHello`
  - then rebuilt a second full `ClientHello` with a fresh `random` / `legacy_session_id`
  - this made the computed binder inconsistent with the bytes actually sent on the wire
- Fixed that root cause by adding a safer builder path in `tls13.clienthello`:

## 2026-03-27 Progress (TLS 1.3 ClientHello PSK extension validation)
- Followed the repo review lead into a protocol-hardening batch instead of reopening broader roadmap work.
- Root-cause audit showed the issue was localized to `fafafa.ssl.tls13.clienthello.parser`, not the builder:
  - builder already kept `pre_shared_key` last
  - parser accepted trailing extensions after `pre_shared_key`
  - binder transcript reconstruction ignored any suffix after `pre_shared_key`
  - parser also accepted `early_data` without `pre_shared_key`
- Added focused RED coverage in `tests/test_tls13_resumption.pas`:
  - appended a trailing extension after `pre_shared_key` and asserted parser/helper must reject it
  - appended `early_data` onto a non-PSK `ClientHello` and asserted parser must reject it
- RED evidence:
  - `mkdir -p tmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_red && fpc -B -Fu./src -Fu./tests -Fu./tests/framework -FUtmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_red -FEtmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_red -otmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_red/test_tls13_resumption tests/test_tls13_resumption.pas && ./tmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_red/test_tls13_resumption` => FAIL (`ClientHello with trailing extension after pre_shared_key must be rejected`)
- Applied the minimal production fix only in `src/fafafa.ssl.tls13.clienthello.parser.pas`:
  - tracked whether the `pre_shared_key` extension had already been seen
  - rejected any subsequent extension once `pre_shared_key` was present
  - rejected `HasEarlyData=True` when `pre_shared_key` was absent
  - made binder transcript reconstruction fail if `pre_shared_key` is not the final extension
- GREEN verification:
  - `mkdir -p tmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_green && fpc -B -Fu./src -Fu./tests -Fu./tests/framework -FUtmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_green -FEtmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_green -otmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_green/test_tls13_resumption tests/test_tls13_resumption.pas && ./tmp/tls13_resumption_psk_validation_green/test_tls13_resumption` => PASS
- Adjacent verification:
  - `bash scripts/run_freepascal_tls13_completeness_gate.sh --fast-local` => PASS
  - `git diff --check -- docs/plans/2026-03-27-tls13-clienthello-psk-extension-validation.md src/fafafa.ssl.tls13.clienthello.parser.pas tests/test_tls13_resumption.pas task_plan.md findings.md progress.md` => PASS
- Outcome:
  - `ClientHello` PSK/early-data primitives are now enforced on the parser side, not just emitted correctly by the builder
  - binder transcript reconstruction no longer silently tolerates illegal trailing extensions after `pre_shared_key`
  - the batch stayed scoped to parser hardening plus regression coverage
